title: handwriter texo checkpoints
description: Private: Texo (alephpi/FormulaNet, AGPL-3.0) base weights + handwriter fine-tuned checkpoints on MathWriting (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): v1, v2 best, v3 best (deepcopy 62.55% exact), v4 best (colour InkML 63.98%; not for photos), and v5 best (shipped default; mixed colour/grey/photo; colour 63.91%, grey InkML 63.80%, deepcopy 63.72% exact) for the v6 continue run. Plus handwriter code.
